evals.prompt: Find 40 Estonian gaming creators with 2k to 50k followers, TikTok and YouTube. Keep it under 200 credits.
evals.expected_output: Runs `scout run --market ee` with a hidden-gems style band and budget <= 200, judges candidates with the rubric (verbatim evidence), resumes until done, passes `scout check`, and reports accepted count, credits, yield by source and the XLSX path.

evals.prompt: We already work with a few Finnish Minecraft YouTubers. Expand the list with similar creators we don't know yet.
evals.expected_output: Uses the Finland market with YouTube enabled, uses existing partners as seeds only if a partner list is configured (`scout partner-seeds`, `--partner-seeds`), excludes already-known creators, and flags existing partners instead of presenting them as new.

evals.prompt: German PC-build creators under 20k followers — who is worth a gifted PC?
evals.expected_output: Runs the Germany market with an explicit band up to 20k, favours tech review / gaming gear niches and trust-content scores in the report, and marks competitor sponsorships as risks.
